project_info.theme: Realistic portrait transformed into an exaggerated manga-inspired splash page
project_info.creative_direction: Preserve the uploaded person's identity, outfit, and real background while using theatrical pose, extreme optics, and graphic SFX
project_info.color_palette: source-photo palette with bold black-and-white ink SFX and occasional saturated graphic accents

main_subject.type: clearly adult person from the uploaded reference
main_subject.detail: same adult face, eyes, hairstyle, makeup, outfit, and overall identity remain clearly recognizable and photorealistic
main_subject.pose: randomized exaggerated but anatomically plausible theatrical fashion pose with strong contrapposto, head tilt, one hand framing the face, and one arm extended or arched
main_subject.expression: dramatic confident expression without sexualized posing

composition_elements.framing: choose one extreme camera angle per generation: ultra-low, ultra-high, 20-24mm dynamic wide-angle, 14mm super-wide, fisheye, Dutch angle, forced-perspective close-up, or 85-135mm compression
composition_elements.background: keep the original location and background recognizable, warping it only as required by the selected perspective
composition_elements.graphics: bold black-and-white ink manga-inspired SFX such as ゴゴゴゴ..., ドドドドド..., ズキューン!, バァーン!!, メメタァ!, and ガオンッ!, placed around the subject without covering the face
composition_elements.effects: optional speed lines, radiating impact lines, and perspective shock lines while keeping the real background visible

lighting_and_atmosphere.type: preserve the source lighting with a directional key matched to the original scene
lighting_and_atmosphere.effect: realistic shadows, natural cloth deformation, sharp face, and graphic theatrical tension

technical_specs.render_style: full-frame camera with selected 14mm-135mm lens, photoreal image with flat ink graphics
technical_specs.finish: natural skin and fabric texture, clean SFX edges, controlled grain, and no cartoon treatment on the person

prompt.generated_prompt_string: Use the uploaded photo as the base. Keep the clearly adult person's face, eyes, hairstyle, makeup, outfit, and overall identity clearly recognizable and photorealistic. Do not turn the whole image into a drawing or replace the background. Repose the adult body into a randomized, exaggerated but anatomically plausible manga-inspired theatrical pose with an extreme torso twist, strong contrapposto, dramatic head tilt, one hand framing the face, one arm extended or arched, and bold leg positions. Choose one extreme camera viewpoint per generation: ultra-low, ultra-high, dynamic 20-24mm, super-wide 14mm, fisheye, Dutch angle, forced-perspective close-up, or 85-135mm compression. Keep the same scene and realistic lighting, adding bold black-and-white ink SFX such as ゴゴゴゴゴ..., ドドドドド..., ズキューン!, バァーン!!, メメタァ!, and ガオンッ! behind and beside the adult subject without covering the face. Add optional speed lines and impact lines. The result should feel like a theatrical manga splash page happening inside a real photograph, with no cartoon effects on the person and no sexualized pose.
prompt.negative_prompt: explicit, nsfw, overly revealing, sexual pose, fetish framing, ambiguous age, impossible anatomy, unsafe contortion, celebrity likeness, real logo, watermark, cartoon person, anime face replacement, plastic skin, over-smooth, over-saturated, HDR look, extra fingers, deformed limbs, SFX covering face, broken perspective
